provenance_note: Original proposed art values for a future lab; no engine image, physical calibration, external asset, or production contract is claimed.

coordinate_contract.outlet_anchor: Authoring origin at the center of the validated visual outlet. The outlet direction is a finite nonzero vector in the resolved model/world frame.
coordinate_contract.scale_reference: D is the authored visual nozzle diameter. All *_d geometry values are dimensionless multiples of D, not physical dimensions or measurements.
coordinate_contract.adapter: Construct a right-handed basis aligning local +Z with the validated outward exhaust direction. The existing smoke resolver aligns local -Z with exhaust, so apply a local Y rotation of pi or build an equivalent dedicated basis.
coordinate_contract.transform_rules: Admit only finite, nonsingular, orientation-preserving transforms with orthogonal axes and positive uniform scale. Apply model/parent rotation and the authored diameter once. Reject nonuniform scale, shear, reflection or invalid/zero direction with an actionable diagnostic; never guess an emitter pose.
coordinate_contract.illustrative_diameter_scope: Visual test input only; derived from an existing approximate 0.025 m visual radius, not a measurement or engine nozzle-area claim.
coordinate_contract.diameter_range_scope: Proposed finite positive lab input guard only; it is not an aircraft contract or calibrated physical limit.
coordinate_contract.transform_tolerance: Define and test an explicit numerical tolerance for orthogonality and equal scale in the eventual adapter; this draft does not set a production threshold.

appearance_contract.state_boundary: Appearance consumes a validated normalized visual level and an accepted, pose-aligned presentation time. An AB installation may publish its accepted actual AB amount to the visual adapter; the LED ring consumes a separate cosmetic presentation signal.
appearance_contract.no_physical_meaning: Level, dimensions, colors, cell contrast, rates, and light gains are art controls only. They do not set or infer engine force, fuel demand, nozzle pressure, or measured temperature.
appearance_contract.color_encoding: All color_srgb components are authored in sRGB in [0,1]. Convert once to the active renderer working space. Linear emission_gain is a relative art multiplier, not luminance or temperature.
appearance_contract.data_encoding: Noise and flow textures are scalar/vector data, not color: no source_color conversion. Alpha is coverage, authored separately from sRGB color.
appearance_contract.visibility: Use normal depth testing, no plume depth writes, and no shadow casting. Comparison of additive versus alpha blending is a planned renderer decision.
appearance_contract.timeline: Derive bounded phases from the same unwrapped float64 presentation time as the displayed pose; do not interpolate wrapped angles. Pause freezes the presentation timeline.
appearance_contract.sharing: Share immutable geometry, shader and prepared textures where safe; keep mutable per-outlet state independent. Starting globally Effects Off creates no AB-owned effect resources. On to Off releases AB-owned resources and suspends AB updates after normal deferred cleanup; account separately for shared caches owned or still needed by other systems.
appearance_contract.custom_channel: Do not clobber CUSTOM.z in the existing smoke shader: it stores a seed. Standard particle animation expects that channel; reserve a new explicit contract or a separate shader before enabling an atlas.

per_outlet_dynamic_state.visual_level: Finite normalized art control in [0,1], sourced according to the selected profile.
per_outlet_dynamic_state.presented_pose_and_time: Interpolated outlet transform and its matching unwrapped float64 presentation timestamp.
per_outlet_dynamic_state.bounded_phase_and_seed: Phases recomputed from unwrapped time; stable per-outlet seed and identity, independent of global call order.
per_outlet_dynamic_state.per_view_lod: Each view may choose a fine-detail LOD from its own internal pixels; it must not advance simulation or duplicate particle births.
per_outlet_dynamic_state.optional_particle_history: Owned independently per outlet with bounded capacity, swept births, one carrier-velocity owner and discontinuity reset.
per_outlet_dynamic_state.sharing_policy: Shader and texture data may be immutable/shared; dynamic uniforms, animation and particle histories must remain isolated.

appearance_contract.bounds: The supplied conservative local bounds are illustrative for the listed maximum geometry/deformation in D units; recompute and validate them whenever geometry, deformation or effective scale changes.
appearance_contract.core_representation: A coherent core can be a term in one shell, a core disc, or a separate inner layer; select after visual and native-cost comparison.
appearance_contract.metal_and_interior: No hot-metal or separately illuminated nozzle-interior channel is enabled initially; aperture color below represents gas emission, not a material temperature.

shared_assets.role: Reusable low-frequency data modulation across all plume profiles; the LED profile does not need to load it.
shared_assets.preparation: Request once during selected-profile loading. Connect changed before triggering generation, track successful readiness, handle already-ready/failure/teardown, and measure first synchronous generation. Share the immutable result, not mutable per-outlet uniforms.
shared_assets.runtime_qualification: Confirm generator settings, readiness, seams and actual formats on the pinned binary and each renderer; values are a proposed recipe, not a pre-existing texture.

common_art_policy.recommended_motion_scope: Animation frequencies are look-development starting points, not measured combustion frequencies.
common_art_policy.lod_metric: Approximate projected outlet diameter in internal render pixels, with hysteresis.
common_art_policy.lod_note: Proposed initial hysteresis values for a lab comparison, not validated visual thresholds; hold prior state between them. Keep the coherent core when fine detail is removed.
